name: workflow-shellcheck-findings-deferred
body:
The gate's workflow step runs `actionlint -shellcheck=` so embedded-shell style findings are not gated. Limit: three pre-existing shellcheck findings in this workflow stay unsurfaced — SC2035 twice in the merge-checksums step (around lines 242–243) and SC2001 in the normalize-bottle-filenames step (around line 250) — and a real shell defect in the workflow would not be caught by the gate either. The flag is deliberate: linting the embedded shell would turn those pre-existing findings into a red gate for every agent on a machine with shellcheck installed, and a machine-dependent pass/fail (shellcheck is ambient, not a repo dependency). Upgrade by fixing the three findings, then dropping `-shellcheck=` from the gate step so the workflow's embedded shell is linted.

Two further limits on this workflow. (1) The Go module cache key names the single file `src/golib/go.sum`; upgrade to a glob (e.g. `**/go.sum`) when a second Go module or a `go.work` is added, otherwise the cache key silently misses the new module's dependencies. (2) The `ubuntu-24.04` pin on the linux x86_64 leg is a deliberate stop-gap for the `ubuntu-latest` 24.04-to-26.04 migration; upgrade both legs together to `ubuntu-26.04` once `ubuntu-24.04-arm` is retired, otherwise the legs drift apart.
